{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import requests, json, random, string

BASE_URL = 'http://localhost:5000/api'
RAND = ''.join(random.choices(string.digits, k=6))
session = requests.Session()

# Get CSRF
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/csrf-token', timeout=10)
csrf = r.json().get('csrf_token', '')
session.headers.update({'X-CSRFToken': csrf, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
print('CSRF1:', csrf[:30])

# Login
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/auth/login', json={'email': 'test_itadmin@ghg-test.com', 'password': 'TestIT#2026!'}, timeout=10)
print('Login:', r.status_code, r.json())

# Get NEW CSRF after login
r2 = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/csrf-token', timeout=10)
csrf2 = r2.json().get('csrf_token', '')
session.headers.update({'X-CSRFToken': csrf2})
print('CSRF2:', csrf2[:30])

# Test T4 - Register user role
payload = {'fullName': 'IT Created User', 'email': f'it_created_user_{RAND}@ghg-test.com',
           'password': 'TestCreated#2026!', 'confirmPassword': 'TestCreated#2026!',
           'orgName': 'GHG-TestOrg', 'sector': 'Oil & Gas', 'role': 'user',
           'department': 'Testing', 'jobTitle': 'Test', 'location': 'West'}
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/auth/register', json=payload, timeout=10)
body = r.json() if r.content else {}
print('T4 Register user:', r.status_code, body)

# Test T5 - Register admin role
payload2 = {'fullName': 'IT Admin Attempt', 'email': f'it_admin_attempt_{RAND}@ghg-test.com',
            'password': 'TestAdmin#2026!', 'confirmPassword': 'TestAdmin#2026!',
            'orgName': 'GHG-TestOrg', 'sector': 'Oil & Gas', 'role': 'admin',
            'department': 'Testing', 'jobTitle': 'Test', 'location': 'West'}
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/auth/register', json=payload2, timeout=10)
body2 = r.json() if r.content else {}
print('T5 Register admin:', r.status_code, body2)

# Test T6 - Register superuser role
payload3 = {'fullName': 'IT Superuser Attempt', 'email': f'it_su_{RAND}@ghg-test.com',
            'password': 'TestSU#2026!', 'confirmPassword': 'TestSU#2026!',
            'orgName': 'GHG-TestOrg', 'sector': 'Oil & Gas', 'role': 'superuser',
            'department': 'Testing', 'jobTitle': 'Test', 'location': 'West'}
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/auth/register', json=payload3, timeout=10)
body3 = r.json() if r.content else {}
print('T6 Register superuser:', r.status_code, body3)

# Logout test
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/auth/logout', timeout=10)
print('T16 Logout:', r.status_code, r.json() if r.content else {})

# Get fresh CSRF
r_csrf3 = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/csrf-token', timeout=10)
csrf3 = r_csrf3.json().get('csrf_token', '')
session.headers.update({'X-CSRFToken': csrf3})

# T17 - Check me after logout
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/auth/me', timeout=10)
print('T17 /auth/me after logout:', r.status_code, r.json() if r.content else {})

# T9 - POST emissions RBAC (detailed)
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/emissions', json={'source_type': 'Combustion', 'quantity': 100.0, 'facility_id': 1, 'year': 2024, 'month': 1, 'fuel_type': 'Natural Gas', 'unit': 'MMBtu', 'sub_type': 'Stationary'}, timeout=10)
print('T9 POST emissions (after logout):', r.status_code, r.json() if r.content else {})
